checks.name: Bus voltage magnitudes against the solution printed in the book
checks.reference: P. M. Anderson and A. A. Fouad, Power System Control and Stability, 2nd ed. (2003), Chapter 2, the nine-bus power flow solution (page 38), as quoted in Table 1 of ETAP's validation case TCS-LF-008, Load Flow Comparison Case 2 (https://etap.com/docs/default-source/validation-case-documents/etap_comparisonresults_lf2.pdf, retrieved 2026-11-17). The book prints the magnitudes to three decimals, so the tolerance is the rounding (0.0005) and a little over.

checks.name: Angles of the generator buses against the solution printed in the book
checks.reference: P. M. Anderson and A. A. Fouad, Power System Control and Stability, 2nd ed. (2003), Chapter 2, the nine-bus power flow solution (page 38), as quoted in Table 1 of ETAP's validation case TCS-LF-008, Load Flow Comparison Case 2 (https://etap.com/docs/default-source/validation-case-documents/etap_comparisonresults_lf2.pdf, retrieved 2026-11-17). The book prints the angles to 0.1 degree, so the tolerance is the rounding (0.05) and a little over. The quoted table gives no usable angle for the other buses.

checks.name: Slack active power against the solution printed in the book
checks.reference: P. M. Anderson and A. A. Fouad, Power System Control and Stability, 2nd ed. (2003), Chapter 2, the nine-bus power flow solution (page 38), as quoted in Table 1 of ETAP's validation case TCS-LF-008, Load Flow Comparison Case 2 (https://etap.com/docs/default-source/validation-case-documents/etap_comparisonresults_lf2.pdf, retrieved 2026-11-17). The book prints 71.6 MW for the generator at bus 1.
